paras: Cnemaspis stellapulvis is a species of diurnal, insectivorous, rock-dwelling gecko endemic to the Mysore Plateau of Karnataka in South India. It occurs only in an isolated hill range near Yadiyur of Mandya district and Tumkur district border.
